messages:
lucy_fin: FYI AuditTrailX (InvoiceMate) reached out with an offer to pilot their billing reconciliation + spend-attribution product. They say they can "attribute spend down to request_id". sharing initial email.
omar_procure: nice. do they support our SKU hierarchy and internal chargeback fields?
reena_pm: need to know if they can map to feature flags/routes. also ask about sampling vs full capture.
ethan_sre: security questions: where logs live, retention, encryption, and if they support VPC peering or private ingest.
vendor_bot: AuditTrailX overview: https://audittrailx.example/demo-invoicemate.pdf (prod features + privacy)
lucy_fin: They propose a CSV + JSON API. Example CSV row in doc:
```
invoice_id,period_start,period_end,customer_id,external_sku,model_name,route,request_id,tokens,usd_cost,tag
INV-A-2026-07,2026-07-01,2026-07-31,RD-88,gen_chat_v2,redwood-open-8k,chat,req-7a9d,450,0.27,trial
```
reena_pm: good, request_id present. Can we join on our logs with that? we'll need consistent request_id propagation.
omar_procure: pricing/contract asks: pilot length, complimentary tokens, conversion discount, termination rights, and SLAs. also want to avoid auto-renew traps.
legal_bot: their sample ToS has a data retention clause of up to 2 years and a right to use aggregated telemetry to "improve product". request deletion window and explicit no-training clause.
ethan_sre: also request: SOC2 type II evidence, pen test report, and support for BYOK (AWS KMS) — we can't hand over plaintext logs.
lucy_fin: reconciliation capabilities: they claim line-item diffs and suggested root-cause tagging (missing request_id, rate-limits, model mismatches). ask for a sample monthly reconciliation PDF.
vendor_bot: AuditTrailX replied: can provide 30-day pilot with 10M token ingest, daily full CSV export, API lookup <200ms 95th. Can sign DPA and limited DPA addendum. BYOK via KMS available. Willing to limit raw retention to 90 days for pilot.
reena_pm: good. we should scope demo tests: 1) token attribution accuracy with synthetic traffic, 2) mismatch detection when we inject rerouting and model-fallbacks, 3) export joinability with our BI pipeline.
omar_procure: commercial redlines I'll push: 1) 30-day price lock on conversion 2) no unilateral price increases for 12 months post-conversion 3) ability to export our raw ingest on demand 4) 60-day termination right for convenience during trial.
legal_bot: add explicit clause: "no training of ML models using customer-provided data or derived data" and delete aggregated datasets on request. Also cap retention of customer-identifiable logs to 90 days unless otherwise agreed.
ethan_sre: for ingest: prefer S3 presigned upload to our private bucket + read-only transform by vendor in their account, or VPC peering. reject models trained on raw logs.
lucy_fin: also request invoice-level audit file: CSV + mapping table showing which internal SKU each line mapped to and why.
vendor_bot: AuditTrailX scheduled demo: Wed 2026-04-07 09:30 PT. Product + engineering will join. Calendar invite sent.
reena_pm: I'll prepare a sanitized 24-hour traffic dump and a short test plan. keep demo internal.
omar_procure: I'll draft SOW + pilot MSA and include the commercial asks. Will share redlines here.
lucy_fin: if the pilot shows >99% mapping accuracy and easy exports, this reduces our month-end reconciliation overhead significantly. :relieved:
legal_bot: I'll prepare the DPA redline and the no-training clause.
ethan_sre: thanks all. btw include a question: do they sample for anomaly detection or run deterministic checks? we need explainability for audits.
reena_pm: noted. ok team, next steps: omar to send SOW, reena to prep test data, lucy to list reconciliation KPIs, legal to prep redlines. Post updates here.
omar_procure: will do. ping me if you want specific wording for the price-lock clause.
lucy_fin: thanks :wave:
